original_document.title: WE Business FWA | 4G & 5G Fixed Wireless Internet for Corporates | Telecom Egypt - TE Business - Telecom Egypt

chunks.text: WE Business FWA Bundles: - WE Business FWA 290: Quota 40,000 MBs, Price/month 290 EGP. - WE Business FWA 460: Quota 105,000 MBs, Price/month 460 EGP. - WE Business FWA 690: Quota 200,000 MBs, Price/month 690 EGP. - WE Business FWA 1040: Quota 325,000 MBs, Price/month 1040 EGP. - WE Business FWA 1270: Quota 400,000 MBs, Price/month 1270 EGP. Add-on Bundles: - WE Business FWA ADD-ON 17: 3000 MBs, Price 17 EGP. - WE Business FWA ADD-ON 52: 9,500 MBs, Price 52 EGP. - WE Business FWA ADD-ON 80: 12,000 MBs, Price 80 EGP. - WE Business FWA ADD-ON 115: 20,000 MBs, Price 115 EGP.

Terms & Conditions: - WE Business FWA Router works on WE Network coverage and is locked on the WE data SIM. - To subscribe contact your account manager or call 522 for more details. - You can choose between 4G or 5G routers. - WE Business FWA 290 and 460 bundles are used in one location. - WE Business FWA 690, 1040 & 1270 bundles can be used in two locations. - You can add extra location with 40 EGP paid once life time. - Bundle automatically renews every 30 days. - Add-on packages are available on-demand and not automatically renewed. - Add-on packages are valid for 30 days. - Prices Excluding Taxes. - Change of location requests should be done through customer care 522.
